title: acer negundo subsp. interior
intro: Acer negundo subsp. interior, commonly known as the Interior Boxelder, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapindaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and other ailments. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for wound healing and reducing oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Acer negundo subsp. interior include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
